whatItDoes: We are a restaurant in Batroun, we do Lebanese food, mostly manakish in the morning and grills and mezze at night. My mother's recipes. We have a terrace facing the sea.
locationAndContact: Batroun old souk, near the church. Phone 03 456 789. Open every day 8am to midnight, in winter we close at 10pm. Email beitelzaatar.batroun@gmail.com
customers: Families from Beirut on weekends, tourists, and people from Batroun for breakfast
mainGoal: People should book tables for the weekend, we get full and I lose bookings on WhatsApp. Also show the terrace.
productsAndServices: Manakish zaatar, manakish cheese, kafta grill, mixed grill, mezze platter for 4, fattoush, hummus, knefe. I don't want to show prices.
features: contact form, map, instagram, a gallery of the terrace and food
brand: We have a logo, green and orange. No fonts I think.
dislikedSites: I hate the sites that look like hotels, all black and gold
anythingElse: Instagram is @beitelzaatar.batroun. We also do catering for weddings but not sure if to put it.
